name: marimo_create_widgets_setup
description: Generates and refines upon a marimo widget.

options:
type: text
value: Default value of text box. Defaults to ''.
placeholder: Placeholder text to display when the text area is empty. Defaults to ''.
kind: Input kind. Defaults to 'text'.
max_length: Maximum length of input. Defaults to None.
disabled: Whether the input is disabled. Defaults to False.
debounce: Whether the input is debounced. If number, debounce by that many milliseconds. If True, then value is only emitted on Enter or when the input loses focus. Defaults to True.
label: Markdown label for the element. Defaults to ''.
full_width: Whether the input should take up the full width of its container. Defaults to False.
type: text_area
value: Initial value of the text area. Defaults to ''.
placeholder: Placeholder text to display when the text area is empty. Defaults to ''.
max_length: Maximum length of input. Defaults to None.
disabled: Whether the input is disabled. Defaults to False.
debounce: Whether the input is debounced. If number, debounce by that many milliseconds. If True, then value is only emitted on Ctrl+Enter or when the input loses focus. Defaults to True.
rows: Number of rows of text to display. Defaults to None.
label: Markdown label for the element. Defaults to ''.
full_width: Whether the input should take up the full width of its container. Defaults to False.
type: switch
value: Default value, True or False. Defaults to False.
label: Markdown label for the element. Defaults to ''.
disabled: Whether the element is disabled. Defaults to False.
type: slider
start: The minimum value of the interval. Defaults to None.
stop: The maximum value of the interval. Defaults to None.
step: The slider increment. Defaults to None.
value: Default value. Defaults to None.
debounce: Whether to debounce the slider to only send the value on mouse-up or drag-end. Defaults to False.
disabled: Whether the slider is disabled. Defaults to False.
orientation: The orientation of the slider, either 'horizontal' or 'vertical'. Defaults to 'horizontal'.
show_value: Whether to display the current value of the slider. Defaults to False.
include_input: Whether to display an editable input with the current value of the slider. Defaults to False.
steps: List of steps to customize the slider, mutually exclusive with start, stop, and step. Defaults to None.
label: Markdown label for the element. Defaults to ''.
full_width: Whether the input should take up the full width of its container. Defaults to False.
type: run_button
kind: Button style. Defaults to 'neutral'.
disabled: Whether the button is disabled. Defaults to False.
tooltip: A tooltip to display for the button. Defaults to None.
label: Markdown label for the element. Defaults to 'click to run'.
full_width: Whether the input should take up the full width of its container. Defaults to False.
keyboard_shortcut: Keyboard shortcut to trigger the button (e.g. 'Ctrl-L'). Defaults to None.
type: radio
options: Sequence of text options, or dict mapping option name to option value.
value: Default option name, if None, starts with nothing checked. Defaults to None.
inline: Whether to display options inline. Defaults to False.
label: Optional markdown label for the element. Defaults to ''.
disabled: Whether the radio group is disabled. Defaults to False.
type: range_slider
start: The minimum value of the interval. Defaults to None.
stop: The maximum value of the interval. Defaults to None.
step: The slider increment. Defaults to None.
value: Default value. Defaults to None.
debounce: Whether to debounce the slider to only send the value on mouse-up or drag-end. Defaults to False.
orientation: The orientation of the slider, either 'horizontal' or 'vertical'. Defaults to 'horizontal'.
show_value: Whether to display the current value of the slider. Defaults to False.
steps: List of steps to customize the slider, mutually exclusive with start, stop, and step. Defaults to None.
label: Markdown label for the element. Defaults to ''.
full_width: Whether the input should take up the full width of its container. Defaults to False.
disabled: Whether the slider is disabled. Defaults to False.
type: number
start: The minimum value of the interval. Defaults to None.
stop: The maximum value of the interval. Defaults to None.
step: The number increment. Defaults to None.
value: The default value. Defaults to None.
debounce: Whether to debounce (rate-limit) value updates from the frontend. Defaults to False.
label: Markdown label for the element. Defaults to ''.
full_width: Whether the input should take up the full width of its container. Defaults to False.
disabled: Whether the input is disabled. Defaults to False.
type: multiselect
options: Sequence of options, or dict mapping option name to option value. If the options are not strings, they will be converted to strings when displayed in the dropdown.
value: A list of initially selected options. Defaults to None.
label: Markdown label for the element. Defaults to ''.
full_width: Whether the input should take up the full width of its container. Defaults to False.
max_selections: Maximum number of items that can be selected. Defaults to None.
disabled: Whether the multiselect is disabled. Defaults to False.
type: file_browser
initial_path: Starting directory. Defaults to current working directory.
filetypes: The file types to display in each directory; for example, filetypes=['.txt', '.csv']. If None, all files are displayed. Defaults to None.
filter: An additional filter applied to files (directories are always shown for navigation). Accepts a regex string or compiled pattern matched against the filename, or a callable that receives the file's Path and returns True to include it. Applied together with filetypes (both must match). Defaults to None.
selection_mode: Which kinds of entries the user can select. Accepts one of 'file' (default), 'directory', 'all', or a list/tuple containing 'file' and/or 'directory'. Defaults to 'file'.
multiple: If True, allow the user to select multiple files. Defaults to True.
restrict_navigation: If True, prevent the user from navigating any level above the given path. Defaults to False.
ignore_empty_dirs: If True, hide directories that contain no files (recursively). Defaults to False.
limit: Maximum number of files to display. If None (default), automatically chooses 50 for cloud storage or 10000 for local filesystems.
label: Markdown label for the element. Defaults to ''.
type: file
filetypes: The file types accepted; for example, filetypes=['.png', '.jpg']. If None, all files are accepted. In addition to extensions, you may provide 'audio/*', 'video/*', or 'image/*' to accept any audio, video, or image file. Defaults to None.
multiple: If True, allow the user to upload multiple files. Defaults to False.
kind: Type of upload interface. Defaults to 'button'.
max_size: The maximum size of the file to upload (in bytes). Defaults to 100000000.
label: Markdown label for the element. Defaults to ''.
type: dropdown
options: Sequence of options, or dict mapping option name to option value. If the options are not strings, they will be converted to strings when displayed in the dropdown.
value: Default option name. Defaults to None.
allow_select_none: Whether to include special option ('--') for a None value; when None, defaults to True when value is None. Defaults to None.
searchable: Whether to enable search functionality. Defaults to False. If the number of options is greater than 1000, this will be set to True, automatically.
label: Markdown label for the element. Defaults to ''.
full_width: Whether the input should take up the full width of its container. Defaults to False.
disabled: Whether the dropdown is disabled. Defaults to False.
type: date
start: Minimum date selectable. If None, defaults to 01-01-0001.
stop: Maximum date selectable. If None, defaults to 12-31-9999.
value: Default date. If None and start and stop are None, defaults to the current day. If None and start is not None, defaults to start. If None and stop is not None, defaults to stop.
label: Markdown label for the element. Defaults to ''.
full_width: Whether the input should take up the full width of its container. Defaults to False.
disabled: Whether the input should be disabled. Defaults to False.
type: datetime
start: The minimum selectable datetime. Defaults to minimum datetime.
stop: The maximum selectable datetime. Defaults to maximum datetime.
value: Default value. Defaults to None.
precision: The precision of the datetime picker. Defaults to 'minute'.
label: Markdown label for the element. Defaults to None.
full_width: Whether the input should take up the full width of its container. Defaults to False.
disabled: Whether the input should be disabled. Defaults to False.
type: date_range
start: Minimum date selectable. If None, defaults to 01-01-0001.
stop: Maximum date selectable. If None, defaults to 12-31-9999.
value: Default value as (start_date, end_date). If None, defaults to (start, stop) if provided, otherwise today's date for both.
label: Markdown label for the element. Defaults to None.
full_width: Whether the input should take up the full width of its container. Defaults to False.
disabled: Whether the input should be disabled. Defaults to False.
type: code_editor
value: Initial value of the code editor. Defaults to ''.
language: Language of the code editor. Most major languages are supported, including 'sql', 'javascript', 'typescript', 'html', 'css', 'c', 'cpp', 'rust', and more. Defaults to 'python'.
placeholder: Placeholder text to display when the code editor is empty. Defaults to ''.
theme: Theme of the code editor. Defaults to the editor's default.
disabled: Whether the input is disabled. Defaults to False.
min_height: Minimum height of the code editor in pixels. Defaults to None.
max_height: Maximum height of the code editor in pixels. Defaults to None.
label: Markdown label for the element. Defaults to ''.
show_copy_button: Whether to show a button to copy the code to the clipboard. Defaults to True.
debounce: Whether the input is debounced. If number, debounce by that many milliseconds. If True, then value is only emitted when the input loses focus. Defaults to False.
type: checkbox
value: Default value, True or False. Defaults to False.
label: Markdown label for the element. Defaults to ''.
disabled: Whether the checkbox is disabled. Defaults to False.
type: button
value: An initial value for the button. Defaults to None.
kind: Button style. Defaults to 'neutral'.
disabled: Whether the button is disabled. Defaults to False.
tooltip: Tooltip text for the button. Defaults to None.
label: Markdown label for the element. Defaults to 'click here'.
full_width: Whether the input should take up the full width of its container. Defaults to False.
keyboard_shortcut: Keyboard shortcut to trigger the button (e.g. 'Ctrl-L'). Defaults to None.
